name: São Francisco Square in the Town of São Cristóvão
description: In São Cristóvão, one of Brazil's oldest towns, in the state of Sergipe, this stone-paved plaza measures about 73 by 51 metres. It is framed by a Franciscan church and convent, a charity hospital and church, and the old Provincial Palace. Its layout blends Spanish and Portuguese town planning, a rare mix that gives the square its distinctive colonial character.
